purpose: proves the evaluator's pass/fail verdict is unaffected by the oh-my-pi 18.1.11-1 -> 18.1.13-1 upgrade that drifted environmentHash() mid-run
method: re-ran the 182 resolutions already evaluated under the frozen environment, under the current one (patched evaluator.environment_sha256 only; evaluator, scaffold, oracle, toolchain-of-record all otherwise untouched), and compared pass/category/candidate_sha256/per-stage exit status
drift_cause: pacman upgrade of oh-my-pi 18.1.11-1 -> 18.1.13-1 at 2026-09-07T18:45:45Z, mid-run; environmentHash() hashes the full `pacman -Q` package list plus binary hashes of the nine evaluator tools (git, tree-sitter, bwrap, diff3, mergiraf, cc, cmake, make, go)
scope_of_diff_verified: reconstructing the prior pacman -Q with only the oh-my-pi version string reverted reproduces the frozen hash bit-for-bit; oh-my-pi owns 21 files (/usr/bin/omp, /usr/lib/oh-my-pi, shell completions) touching none of the nine evaluator tool binaries, whose mtimes all predate the run
scope_note: This receipt covers the 182 resolutions that had already been evaluated pre-drift and were re-evaluated post-drift for direct comparison. The remaining 451 of 633 total resolutions were evaluated only once, under the drifted environment; their validity rests on induction from this 182-case check, not a second cross-check.
